variables.input:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "SECURITY_EVENT"
| filter event.category == "VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT"
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace"
| filter event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" | filter event.level == "ENTITY" | summarize takeLast(vulnerability.id), by: affected_entity.management_zones.names | fields values = affected_entity.management_zones.names | fields values = array("All", values)

0.title: Vulnerabilities by Host and Process
0.query:
fetch events
 | filter event.kind=="SECURITY_EVENT" and event.category=="VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT" and event.provider=="Dynatrace" 
     and event.type=="VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and  event.level=="ENTITY" and vulnerability.stack == "CODE_LIBRARY"
 | filter in("All",$ManagementZone) OR in(affected_entity.management_zones.names,$ManagementZone)
 | sort timestamp desc
 | summarize by:{ID=vulnerability.display_id, pg=affected_entity.id}, {
 `Process IDs`=takeFirst( affected_entity.affected_processes.ids),
 Last_update=takeFirst(timestamp), 
 Description=takeFirst(event.description), 
 Score=takeFirst(vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.score), 
 Level=takeFirst(vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.level),
 Title=takeFirst(vulnerability.title),
 Status=takeFirst(vulnerability.status),
 CVE=takeFirst(vulnerability.reference.cve),
 Technology=takeFirst(vulnerability.technology),
 URL=takeFirst(vulnerability.url),
 `Public Exposure`=takeFirst(vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.exposure_status),
 `Reachable Data`=takeFirst(vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.data_assets_status),
 `Vulnerable Function`=takeFirst(vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.vulnerable_function_status),
 Muted=takeFirst(vulnerability.mute_status),
 MZ=takeFirst(affected_entity.management_zones.names)
 }
 | expand pid=`Process IDs`
 | lookup [fetch dt.entity.process_group_instance
    | fields process_id=id, process_name=entity.name, host_id=belongs_to[dt.entity.host]
    | lookup [ fetch dt.entity.host], sourceField:host_id, lookupField:id, fields:host_name=entity.name]
    , sourceField:pid, lookupField:process_id, fields:{process_id,process_name, host_id, host_name}
 | fields ID, host_name, process_name, Score, Level, Title, `Public Exposure`, `Reachable Data`, `Vulnerable Function`, URL
 | sort Score desc

1.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind=="SECURITY_EVENT"
| filter event.category=="VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT"
| filter event.provider=="Dynatrace"
| filter event.type=="VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT"
| filter event.level=="ENTITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.stack,{"CODE_LIBRARY","SOFTWARE","CONTAINER_ORCHESTRATION"})
| filter in("All",$ManagementZone) OR in(affected_entity.management_zones.names,$ManagementZone)
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| sort timestamp desc
| summarize by:{vulnerability.display_id, related_entities.hosts.ids}, {risk_level=takefirst(vulnerability.davis_assessment.level), host_name=takeFirst(related_entities.hosts.names)}
| filter isNotNull(related_entities.hosts.ids)
| expand related_entities.hosts.ids
| summarize by:{related_entities.hosts.ids,vulnerability.display_id}, { risk_level=takeFirst(risk_level),host_name=takeFirst(host_name)}
| summarize by:{`Host ID`=related_entities.hosts.ids},{ Total=count(), Critical=countIf(risk_level == "CRITICAL" ), High=countIf(risk_level == "HIGH" ), Medium=countIf(risk_level == "MEDIUM" ), Low=countIf(risk_level == "LOW" ), `Host Name`=takeFirst(host_name)}
| fields   `Host Name`,`Host ID`, Total, Critical, High, Medium, Low
| fields `Host Name` = arrayFirst(`Host Name`), `Host ID`, Total, Critical, High, Medium, Low
| sort Critical desc, High desc, Medium desc

4.query:
fetch events
| filter dt.system.bucket=="default_security_events"
| filter event.provider=="Dynatrace"
| filter event.type=="VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT"
| filter event.level=="ENTITY"
| filter in("All",$ManagementZone) OR in(affected_entity.management_zones.names,$ManagementZone)

// filter only the latest snapshot data
| fieldsAdd matcher="match"
| lookup [
fetch events
| filter dt.system.bucket=="default_security_events"
| filter event.provider=="Dynatrace"
| filter event.type=="VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT"
| filter event.level=="ENTITY"
| filter in("All",$ManagementZone) OR in(affected_entity.management_zones.names,$ManagementZone)
| fields 
maxTimestamp=timestamp,
matcher="match"
| limit 1
], sourceField:matcher, lookupField:matcher
| filter timestamp==lookup.maxTimestamp
//end of filtering for the latest snapshot
| summarize
`Vulnerabilities`=toString(arraySize(collectDistinct(vulnerability.display_id)))
| fields `Total vulnerabilities`=`Vulnerabilities`
